title: The Seventh Person
genre: 生存規則 / 密室 / 心理懸疑
hook: 房間裡只有六個人，但規則說不能尋找第七個人。

six.label: 六個陌生人（劇本未給外觀，此為補充設定，請確認）
six.description: six adult strangers aged 28 to 55 strapped to six metal chairs around a steel table: a balding man in his mid 40s with glasses and a grey sweater, a woman in her late 20s with a ponytail and a white shirt, an athletic man in his early 30s in a dark hoodie, a woman in her mid 50s with short grey hair and a navy cardigan, a thin man in his late 20s with a buzz cut and an olive T-shirt, a bearded man in his late 30s in a checked flannel shirt

seventh.label: 第七個人（補充設定）
seventh.description: a seventh man in his 30s, tall, pale, short dark hair, plain white shirt and dark trousers, an unnervingly calm expression

scenes.title: 六個陌生人在密室醒來
scenes.beat_zh: 六個陌生人同時在密室醒來。所有人被固定在椅子上。牆壁：只有一個人可以離開。
scenes.action: Six strangers wake up at the same moment, groggy and frightened, each strapped by leather straps at the wrists to a metal chair around a steel table; one is lifting his head, another is pulling at the strap.
scenes.setting: a windowless bare concrete room, a long steel table with six metal chairs, an industrial ceiling lamp, a large dark one-way glass panel on one wall, a bold message painted on the far wall
scenes.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent light evenly lighting the whole room, every face and the wall readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the far wall has black painted lettering: "只有一個人可以離開"

compositions.A: high wide shot from a corner of the room, all six people visible around the table, the painted wall at the back
compositions.B: eye-level shot from the end of the table, three faces in sharp focus waking in fear in the foreground, the painted wall legible behind them

scenes.title: 牆上出現三條規則
scenes.beat_zh: 牆壁出現 RULE 01 不要說謊。RULE 02 不要離開座位。RULE 03 不要尋找第七個人。
scenes.action: The six strapped strangers stare up in silence at the wall where three rules are now written, their faces tense and afraid.
scenes.setting: the same windowless concrete room with a steel table, six metal chairs and a dark glass panel, a wall of painted rules facing them
scenes.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent light, a faint glow on the wall text, all faces and the wall readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the wall shows three lines of large white painted text: "RULE 01 不要說謊", "RULE 02 不要離開座位", "RULE 03 不要尋找第七個人"

compositions.A: wide shot from behind the six people, their heads and shoulders in the lower frame, the wall of three rules large and legible in front of them
compositions.B: shot from the side of the wall, the three lines of text in the foreground and the six frightened faces looking up in the middle distance

scenes.title: 燈光熄滅：誰已經死過一次？
scenes.beat_zh: 燈光熄滅。機械聲：誰已經死過一次？
dialogue: 機械聲：誰已經死過一次？
scenes.action: The main lights have gone out and the six strapped strangers sit rigid in the dim room, eyes wide, looking up toward a small ceiling speaker.
scenes.setting: the same windowless concrete room with the steel table and six chairs, a small speaker grille on the ceiling
scenes.lighting: main lights off, the room lit by a small red indicator light on the ceiling speaker and a dim emergency lamp, the faces and table still clearly visible in a dim red-orange glow

compositions.A: wide high shot of the room in dim red light, all six people visible around the table, the glowing red speaker at the top of the frame
compositions.B: medium shot from table level, three frightened faces in the red glow looking upward, the speaker's red light in the soft-focus background

scenes.title: 燈光亮起，桌上出現一把刀
scenes.beat_zh: 燈光亮起。桌面出現一把刀。六人恐懼。
scenes.action: The lights are back on and a single kitchen knife now lies in the middle of the steel table; the six strapped strangers stare at it in terror.
scenes.setting: the same windowless concrete room, steel table with one knife in the centre, six metal chairs, dark glass panel on the wall
scenes.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent light, a sharp highlight on the steel table and the knife blade, all faces readable

compositions.A: high angle shot looking down at the table, the knife in the centre and the six frightened faces around it
compositions.B: low angle at table level, the knife sharp in the foreground and three terrified faces out of focus behind it

scenes.title: 一二三四五六……我們不是六個人
scenes.beat_zh: 一名男人開始數人數。一、二、三、四、五、六……他突然停下。我們不是六個人。
scenes.action: The thin man in the olive T-shirt, strapped to his chair, turns his head slowly counting the people around the table with his eyes; his mouth is open and his face has gone white with sudden realisation while the others look at him.
scenes.setting: the same windowless concrete room, steel table and metal chairs
scenes.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent light, his face clearly lit, the others readable

compositions.A: medium shot from across the table, the thin man in sharp focus at the centre, two or three of the others looking at him on either side
compositions.B: close-up of the thin man's horrified face, his wide eyes fixed on something off to the side, the other strapped people blurred behind him

scenes.title: 玻璃反射中出現七個人
scenes.beat_zh: 玻璃反射中出現七個人。現實中只有六個。
scenes.action: The six strapped strangers sit around the table and look toward a large dark glass panel on the wall; in the reflection in the glass there are seven people around the table, one more than in the room.
scenes.setting: the same windowless concrete room, the large dark glass panel acting as a mirror, the steel table and chairs
scenes.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent light, the glass reflecting the room clearly, all details readable

compositions.A: wide shot with the glass panel filling the right half of the frame, six people in the room at the left and seven people in the reflection
compositions.B: close view of the glass panel, the reflection showing seven people seated and standing around the table, two of the real people's backs at the edge of the frame

scenes.video_note: Counting people in a reflection is hard for the model; judge by whether the 'extra' figure reads clearly.

scenes.title: 第七個人抬頭微笑：ROUND ONE
scenes.beat_zh: 第七個人站在六人之間。慢慢抬頭。對鏡頭微笑。機械聲：ROUND ONE.
scenes.action: The seventh man stands calmly among the six strapped strangers, who stare ahead in terror; he slowly lifts his head and smiles directly into the camera.
scenes.setting: the same windowless concrete room, steel table and chairs, a wall-mounted LED display above the dark glass panel
scenes.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent light on all seven figures, a red glow from the LED display, faces readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the wall-mounted LED display glows red with the text "ROUND ONE"

compositions.A: wide frontal shot, the seventh man standing in the centre between the six seated people, looking up at the camera with a faint smile, the LED display behind him
compositions.B: medium close-up of the seventh man's smiling face in the centre, two of the strapped people blurred on either side in the foreground
